C1715.title: Buyer Abuses Refund-Only Rule to Withhold Payment for iPhone Purchase
C1715.summary: A consumer surnamed Li in Yangzhou, Jiangsu, purchased an iPhone online, applied for a refund-only request while the phone was in transit, and refused to pay after receiving the delivery. After the merchant's repeated attempts to resolve the issue failed, the case was brought to court, where mediation led to Li paying the owed amount.
